propositions: fsck.py is pinned at exactly 800 LOC (the hard cap enforced by CI), blocking any code changes including bug fixes
fsck.py fuses four unrelated concerns: per-ticket store walk, tracker-level health checks, JSON report shaping, and CLI command driving
The file grows monotonically with each new check added to _scan because checks are added inline to the aggregation point rather than being separated by concern
The complexity-ratchet gate forbids new symbols at any ceiling, so moving functions wholesale reads as added debt; decomposing functions under the threshold retires debt instead

Extracting _scan and _check_snapshot to fsck_scan.py and _tracker_health to fsck_tracker_health.py, with further per-check decomposition, reduces fsck.py to 301 LOC and eliminates 43 points of complexity debt
External callers must keep accessing the same fsck module attributes via re-exports, and no test files are edited, to preserve behaviour
